verdict: A genuine DIY home-improvement project entirely distinct from Ora, MSI, and all incubator documents—detailed technical design for a plenum air-filtration system with furniture integration, involving specific component selection, dimensional calculation, and spatial constraints.
best_quote: I'm looking at the space next to my couch in my living room. I used to have an accent chair there, but it didn't fit—the space is only about 36 to 40 inches wide before you hit a decorative Kelvin unit.
